findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant-based document access validation
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this function now still returns `true`, allowing callers to authorize cross-tenant document reads. This directly removes the tenant-isolation check that existed before the PR.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant-based access validation
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, a user can read another tenant’s document, breaking tenant isolation and causing a direct authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
Any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant` is now authorized, allowing cross-tenant document access wherever this exported authorization predicate is used.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
